frameworks.name: EU Artificial Intelligence Act
frameworks.summary: Risk-based horizontal law: bans prohibited practices, high-risk conformity + GPAI model duties, transparency for synthetic content, incident reporting.

frameworks.name: EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice
frameworks.status: in-force (voluntary commitment route to AI Act Ch.V)
frameworks.summary: Operationalizes GPAI duties: transparency documentation, copyright policy, safety/security evals for systemic-risk models.

frameworks.name: EU Revised Product Liability Directive (AI liability)
frameworks.summary: Strict/defect liability extended to software/AI; eases burden of proof, mandated logging evidence disclosure.

frameworks.name: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI (CETS No. 225)
frameworks.summary: First binding AI treaty: human rights, democracy, rule-of-law alignment, lifecycle risk management.

frameworks.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
frameworks.summary: Govern-Map-Measure-Manage functions; cross-sector baseline for trustworthy AI risk management.

frameworks.name: NIST AI 600-1: Generative AI Profile
frameworks.summary: GenAI risk profile extending AI RMF: CBRN, confabulation, IP, environmental, value-chain risks and mitigations.

frameworks.name: NIST AI 100-2e / Adversarial ML Taxonomy
frameworks.summary: Taxonomy of GenAI/predictive-AI attacks (evasion, poisoning, prompt injection, privacy) and mitigations.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 42001 AI Management System
frameworks.summary: Management system for AI (AIMS): policy, objectives, risk, lifecycle controls Annex A/B; certifiable like ISO 27001.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 23894 AI Risk Management
frameworks.summary: Risk management guidance for AI aligned to ISO 31000; complements NIST RMF and EU AI Act risk duties.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 23053 AI Lifecycle Framework
frameworks.summary: ML lifecycle processes: data, training, verification, deployment, operations, decommissioning.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 24029 AI Robustness Assessment
frameworks.summary: Robustness of neural networks: assessment methods, formal/statistical approaches.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 24028 AI Trustworthiness Overview
frameworks.summary: Trustworthiness characteristics: reliability, resilience, controllability, explainability, fairness.

frameworks.name: OECD AI Principles
frameworks.summary: Values-based principles: inclusive growth, human rights, transparency, robustness, accountability; GPAI safety additions 2024.

frameworks.name: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
frameworks.summary: Ethics + Readiness Assessment Methodology (RAM); bans social scoring/mass surveillance uses.

frameworks.name: G7 Hiroshima Process (Intl Guiding Principles + Code of Conduct)
frameworks.summary: 11 guiding principles + voluntary code for advanced foundation-model developers and deployers.

frameworks.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
frameworks.summary: Top LLM risks: prompt injection, data leakage, poisoning, supply chain, excessive agency, overreliance + mitigations.

frameworks.name: OWASP Agentic AI Threats & Mitigations
frameworks.summary: Agent-specific: tool abuse, identity, memory poisoning, cascading failures, human-in-loop gates.

frameworks.name: MITRE ATLAS (Adversarial Threat Landscape for AI Systems)
frameworks.summary: ATT&CK-style AI TTPs across lifecycle: recon, resource dev, initial access, ML attack staging, impact; case studies.

frameworks.name: CSA AI Controls Matrix / Cloud Controls (AI extension)
frameworks.summary: Cloud + AI control mapping: AIS datasets, model management, supply chain, logging for SaaS AI deployments.

frameworks.name: IEEE 7000-Series (Ethical System Design)
frameworks.summary: Ethical elicitation, transparency (7001), ontological impact (7007) for autonomous/intelligent systems.

frameworks.name: US Executive Orders on AI (14110 as amended by 14278)
frameworks.summary: Frontier-model reporting, red-teaming, agency governance; 2025 shift toward innovation + existing-law enforcement.

frameworks.name: US OMB M-24-10 AI Governance (federal)
frameworks.summary: Federal agency AI inventory, rights/safety-impacting use-case controls, CAIO governance, procurement.

frameworks.name: Colorado AI Act (SB 24-205)
frameworks.summary: First US state algorithmic-discrimination law: deployer impact assessments, notices for consequential decisions (hiring, lending, housing).

frameworks.name: California AI Transparency + Training Data Acts
frameworks.summary: Provenance disclosure for GenAI outputs; public training-data summaries for frontier developers.

frameworks.name: UK AI Safety Institute (Inspect evals + guidelines)
frameworks.summary: Frontier evals (Inspect), pro-innovation principles applied by sector regulators, voluntary model testing.

frameworks.name: China Interim Measures for Generative AI Services
frameworks.summary: Security assessment + algorithm filing, training-data legality, content labeling, user-complaint handling.

frameworks.name: China Deep Synthesis (Deepfake) Provisions
frameworks.summary: Consent + conspicuous labeling for synthetic media, recommender transparency, rumor controls.

frameworks.name: Canada AIDA (Bill C-27, Part 3)
frameworks.summary: High-impact system duties: risk assessment, mitigation, monitoring, public reporting; interim voluntary code for GPAI.

frameworks.name: Brazil AI Bill 2338/2023
frameworks.summary: Risk-based + rights-based: prohibited uses, high-risk algorithmic impact assessments, GPAI duties, ANPD oversight.

frameworks.name: Singapore Model AI Governance Framework (+ GenAI Eval Sandbox)
frameworks.summary: Practical self-assessment (ISAGO), human-centricity, operations management; GenAI evaluation sandbox (Moonshot).

frameworks.name: Japan AI Guidelines for Business (v1.0)
frameworks.summary: Soft-law for developers/providers/users: safety, fairness, privacy, transparency, accountability; 10 principles.

frameworks.name: Korea AI Basic Act (Framework Act on AI)
frameworks.summary: Licensing-adjacent duties: transparency labeling, high-impact AI impact assessments, AI Safety Institute.

frameworks.name: India NITI Aayog Responsible AI Principles
frameworks.summary: Principles + use-case risk assessment; sectoral enforcement via existing law (DPDP Act 2023 for privacy).

frameworks.name: Australia Voluntary AI Safety Standard (10 guardrails)
frameworks.summary: 10 guardrails for high-risk settings: testing, human oversight, transparency, contestability; aligns with EU AI Act.
